proposals.name: The Herbarium
proposals.why: Eighteen unlike blossoms pressed flat in one book, each keeping its own color and its true name, and nothing crowded out.

proposals.name: A Slant of Light
proposals.why: A slant light at evening shows the whole page truer than noon, which is how each guardian reads every design.

proposals.name: Sewn by Night
proposals.why: A fascicle is loose sheets sewn by hand into one small book, and by night these eighteen guardians are the thread that holds it.
